cwi.jei.incubator.inoculation: Inoculate a sterile Petri dish before the numbered feed steps.
cwi.jei.incubator.uncapping: Uncap the cultured plate with a %s.
cwi.jei.mineral.deposit: Mining this deposit yields %s; process the ore block.
cwi.jei.mineral.yield: %s: %s guaranteed, plus %s%% chance of one extra
cwi.jei.mineral.milled_crushed: Milling one crushed ore yields one powder.
cwi.jei.mineral.milled_lump: Milling one lump yields one powder.
cwi.jei.mineral.concentrate_furnace: Smelt or blast one concentrate into one ingot.
cwi.jei.mineral.crystal_furnace: Smelt or blast one crystal into one ingot.
cwi.jei.mineral.no_furnace: No ordinary smelting or blasting recipe for this concentrate.
cwi.jei.mineral.lignite_fuel: One lignite lump burns for 20 seconds.
cwi.jei.mineral.lignite_powder: One portion of lignite powder burns for 20 seconds, the same as one lump.
cwi.jei.mineral.returned_culture: The culture is returned after processing; it is not created from the mineral.
cwi.jei.mineral.separate_sulfur: These forms come from separate sulfur ores; this sulfur block has no processing recipe.
cwi.jei.mineral.route.brine_culture: 500 mB raw brine with Vulcan Thermus
cwi.jei.mineral.route.coal_culture: Four lignite lumps with Carbofusor Spirillum
cwi.info.ore.powder: Crushing or milling one ore block gives %s powder feed plus a %s%% chance of one extra. Crushed ore must be milled before separation.
cwi.info.ore.average: Average feed: %s powders per ore block.
cwi.info.ore.separation: Main product: %s. Per 100 powders, vibration averages %s concentrates; centrifugation averages %s. Both leave tailings for flotation.
cwi.info.ore.block_yield: Before tailings recovery, this averages %s concentrates per ore block with vibration or %s with centrifugation.
cwi.info.ore.buffer: These are long-run averages, not guaranteed batch outputs. Keep a buffer between chance-based separation and machines that need steady feed.
cwi.info.ore.byproducts: Other possible concentrates: %s. Give each output its own storage or onward route so it cannot fill the machine.
cwi.info.ore.tailings: Flotation recovers more %s: an average of %s concentrates per 100 tailings. It leaves stubborn tailings.
cwi.info.ore.reagent: A steel vat with a mixer uses water and flotation reagent. Check the reagent's production recipe when setting up the supply line.
cwi.info.ore.stubborn_leachable: Regrinding stubborn tailings has a %s%% chance to recover ore powder. This mineral also supports heated acid leaching; wash its solid leach residue while processing the solution separately.
cwi.info.ore.stubborn_physical: This mineral has no acid-leaching route. Regrinding stubborn tailings has a %s%% chance to recover ore powder for another separation pass.
cwi.info.blast_furnace.bootstrap: Start steel refining with air from an air intake. Oxygen is a later efficiency upgrade, not a requirement for the first steel. Supply molten pig iron, liquid silicon and flux through the furnace hatches.
cwi.info.blast_furnace.heat: Heaters supply heat; reinforcement raises the temperature ceiling. Allow the furnace to warm up. A larger chamber increases parallel capacity, but heater power and reinforcement still limit temperature.
cwi.info.blast_furnace.outputs: Drain steel and slag into separate output storage. A full output can stop processing even when the ingredients and heat are ready.
cwi.info.glass.reusable: The batch mixer returns soda and limestone. Filter those outputs back to the mixer while sending the glass batch onward; only the sand needs a continuous new supply for this step.
cwi.info.glass.recovery: Quenching sometimes produces cracked or devitrified glass. Mill the rejects, then compact four glass powders with heat to reclaim one sintered blank. Send it back through pressing and quenching.
cwi.info.slag.casting: Cast slag into blocks in a casting basin to free the furnace's output tank. Stonecut the blocks into slag bricks for building.
cwi.info.byproduct.washing_residue: This mixed refuse has no recovery recipe. Keep it separate from recoverable fines; a dedicated chute dropping into enclosed lava can dispose of unwanted stock. Filter the waste route so products cannot enter it.
cwi.info.byproduct.blockless_gas: A powered Create pump can discharge this gas through an open pipe facing replaceable air. Keep the pipe end clear. KubeJS carbon dioxide is not accepted by the native TFMG exhaust or smokestack.
cwi.ponder.logistics_filtering.text_1: A brass funnel takes only the item in its filter.
cwi.ponder.logistics_filtering.text_2: Copper passes the iron filter and continues to its own output.
cwi.ponder.logistics_filtering.text_3: Filters choose material types. They do not reserve stock or balance demand.
cwi.ponder.logistics_sharing.text_1: Split divides a stack among available outputs. Here, 12 items can become 4 per lane.
cwi.ponder.logistics_sharing.text_2: If an output backs up, Split skips it. The remaining lanes receive more.
cwi.ponder.logistics_sharing.text_3: Forced Round Robin sends whole stacks in turn. It waits when the next outlet is blocked.
cwi.ponder.logistics_sharing.text_4: Clearing that lane lets the rotation continue. Use equal stack sizes when equal item shares matter.
cwi.ponder.logistics_reserve_priority.te: The lower hopper supplies the workshop. The side funnel exports surplus.
Set the switch to 16 and 64 items, then invert its output. Wire it to the surplus funnel.
While this stock rebuilds toward 64, redstone holds surplus export closed.
At 64 items, export opens. The workshop still has its own outlet.
At 16, surplus closes again. The reserve is protected from export; workshop use can still consume it.
cwi.ponder.logistics_stockpile_hysteresi: Use a lower limit of 16 items and an upper limit of 64. Wire the normal output to the incoming funnel.
While filling, crossing 16 does not stop supply. The funnel remains open until 64.
At 64, the switch powers the funnel and pauses input.
The same stock of 40 now keeps input paused. Between the limits, the previous state is retained.
At 16, input restarts. This gap prevents a small withdrawal from repeatedly switching supply on and off.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.header: Keep Glass Working Stock In Circulation
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_1: This batching module uses a Smart Chute, available in the Precision Age. The upper barrel supplies sand; connect your drive to the shaft.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_2: Keep soda and limestone as working stock inside the basin. Set the basin recipe filter to glass batch.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_3: After mixing, both working powders return. An unfiltered outlet would remove them along with the product.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_4: The chute extracts only glass batch. The returned powders stay available to the mixer for the next batch.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_5: These three batches used the same working powders. Add more sand rather than replacing the carbonate stock.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_6: A full product barrel backs up into the chute and basin. Items remain in inventories; clear the output to restore room.
cwi.ponder.glass_working_stock.text_7: Restart with the working powders still present. Firing, pressing, quenching, and reject recovery belong downstream of this module.
cwi.info.byproduct.fluid_overflow: For optional overflow disposal, seed a dedicated fluid drawer with the intended fluid and lock it with the configuration tool before installing a void upgrade. Matching fluid fills the drawer normally; only excess above capacity is discarded. Stored fluid remains available. Use empty drawers when crafting the tool or upgrade.
cwi.info.byproduct.unfinished_liquid: This liquid has no implemented processing consumer yet. Keep a reserve if wanted, then give surplus its own overflow route so it cannot block the producing line.
cwi.info.byproduct.gas_vent: This gas has no implemented processing consumer yet. Keep a separate reserve if wanted; a powered Create pump can discharge surplus through an open pipe facing replaceable air. Keep the pipe end clear.
